description: Matches (fixtures and results) by day or date range, optionally of one league, or one team's matches in every competition (team_id; without status or dates its latest results, then live, then next matches; with status scheduled only the next ones, with finished only the latest results). Without a date or team: today (UTC). Where known: TV channels by country (where to watch) and a highlights video link.

date_from.description: first day YYYY-MM-DD of a range

date_to.description: last day YYYY-MM-DD of a range

game.description: esports: cs2, dota2, lol or valorant

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

league_name.description: exact league name, picks one division where several share a league id

status.description: scheduled, finished or live, or a status as the API reports it, e.g. FT or NS; with team_id finished lists the latest first; with team_id and no status or date: latest results then next matches

team_id.description: only this team's matches in every competition (team code (or number) from find_teams; not tennis); without a date all of them

name: get_matches
